Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills, with experience managing professional staff.
Experience in developing and facilitating emergency management trainings and exercises.

UCLA is seeking an experienced Assistant Director, Emergency Management to lead campus preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience initiatives. This high-impact role will oversee emergency planning, training, exercises, and EOC operations while collaborating across the university and with external partners. With UCLA serving as an Athlete Village for LA28, this position will help strengthen campus readiness for major events and emerging challenges. The role also provides critical, confidential operational support to campus leadership and Employee & Labor Relations during labor-related events. Join UCLA and help build a safer, more prepared campus community.
